watches.name: Sports Chronograph – Rugby League
watches.description: Stainless Steel – Silver, with black Bezel chronograph. A Partnership Forged in Precision and Power. Tesouro Timepieces and the world of rugby league collide in this exclusive chronograph collaboration with Leigh Leopards players, Keanon Brand & Josh Charnley, a testament to exceptional craftsmanship and unwavering performance. Limited to just 25 pieces worldwide, this timepiece embodies the spirit of the game and the pursuit of perfection. Each watch is meticulously crafted with a robust stainless steel case, ensuring durability and lightweight comfort. The sapphire crystal provides scratch resistance, protecting the Swiss quartz movement at the heart of this watch. The case back is numbered one of 25, further emphasising the exclusivity of this limited edition. This collaboration celebrates the values of strength, skill, and dedication shared by Tesouro Timepieces and the sport of rugby league. A bold and reliable Swiss built sports watch, designed by Tesouro Timepiece. The watch stands out with its striking sunray dial and Black bezel with red seconds hand. What’s more, this watch is made with all our Swiss Made quality features: Swiss Made Quartz Chronograph Movement With Date Stainless Steel Case Sapphire Crystal Water-Resistance Up To 100M/10ATM Supplied In a Tesouro Leather Wrap Case & Silk Pouch Case Size 43mm Jubilee Stainless Steel Bracelet 2-year International Warranty Limited Edition 25 pcs Only World Wide Stainless Steel – Silver, Limited Edition, Quartz Chronograph.

watches.name: GT Club Watch – James Kellett
watches.description: Stainless Steel – Silver, with Red Bezel. Limited to only 25pcs to represent our Partnership with James Kellett for the 2025 GT World Challenge Europe season. James Kellett – 27 year old Racing Driver from Yorkshire. I’ve been racing for nearly 20 years competing all over the world starting in Karting and moving to car racing at the age of 14. I became multiple British Champion by the age of 13 with my Karting highlight being winning the WKA manufacturers cup at the famous Daytona International Speedway in America. The next step for me was racing in the Ginetta Junior championship which turned out to be a fantastic move for my racing career at such a young age. 6 years later and 5 Ginetta championships won in that time felt like an incredible achievement. I didn’t realise at this stage my professional car racing career had only just begun. 2023 getting the opportunity to move into Porsche Cup racing was a huge dream of mine as I never thought it would be possible with the limited budget I had. The year went very well becoming Vice Champion with the most number of wins in my first year racing a Porsche, this aloud be to be spotted by European Porsche teams and gave me the opportunity to race in one of the most prestigious Championships across the world for 2024, Porsche Carrera Cup Deutschland. A crazy year of hard hectic racing against some of the best drivers in the world gave me some incredible results and motivation to push forward in my career even more. 2025 GT World Challenge Endurance For me this championship was a bucket list series due to the huge exposure and the best GT drivers and Manufacturers from all over the world came here to race. With the incredible opportunity from Team Paradine Competition to be able to race in the silver class with 2 other drivers I knew this was exactly where the younger me always dreamt about racing. The 992 Paradine Competition BMW M4GT3 driven by myself, Pedro Ebrahim and Charles Clark took our first win of the series at Paul Ricard and currently lead the silver category going into round 2 at Monza. This is something I’ve worked towards my whole life and I’m excited to continue to push my career further in the future. A bold and reliable Swiss built sports watch, designed by Tesouro Timepiece. The watch stands out with its striking sunray dial and red bezel. What’s more, this watch is made with all our Swiss Made quality features: Swiss Made Quartz Movement With Date Stainless Steel Case Sapphire Crystal Water-Resistance Up To 100M/10ATM Supplied In a Rugged Motorsport Case Case Size 42mm Jubilee Stainless Steel Bracelet 2-year International Warranty Limited Edition 25 pcs Only World Wide With every sale we will donate 5% to James Kellett’s chosen charity. Stainless Steel – Silver, Limited Edition, Quartz Chronograph.

watches.name: Track Edition – Limited Edition
watches.description: Stainless Steel – Black, Blue & Orange Track Edition Chronograph. This is the first Track Edition watch in our new motorsport designed collection. The set consist of the watch with leather and rubber strap as per the image, as well as a black stainless steel bracelet strap, cleaning cloth, warranty card all housed in our new signatory rugged motorsport carry case. The watch itself has a 316L stainless steel 42mm case designed to water resistance of 50mtrs, it also has Sapphire Crystal front glass and a durable black leather and rubber strap. At the heart of the watch is a solid, workhorse Quartz movement from Seiko. This watch has iconic blue and orange racing colour’s with the black markers on the dial which really stands out in the black case, as well as black chronograph dials with matching orange hands. This makes a great combination and shows off an outstanding finish and sporty look to the watch. The dial consists of Hour, Minute and seconds main hands with 24hr, chronograph minutes and chronograph seconds sub dials. The dial is also finished with a date function between 4 and 5 O’clock. Movement: Quartz (Seiko) Glass: Sapphire crystal Case size: 42mm Water resistant: 5ATM Case: Stainless Steel Strap: Leather inner, Rubber outer / Secondary Stainless steel black trap provided. Colour: Black, Blue & Orange Stainless Steel – Black, Limited Edition, Quartz Chronograph.

watches.name: Neptune Field Watch 80th Anniversary
watches.description: Stainless Steel – Leather Strap Luxury, Automatic Field watch design and tested to meet MIL-STD-810G defense environmental standards, making the watch durable for military use. The Neptune boasts a huge spec along with a classic face design combined with a robust, classic case. This is offset with a luxury style back with a centre window showing off the movement working. Designed to withstand MIL-STD-810G: Shock Salt Fog Temperature / Humidity Water ingress Driving rain Pressure 100m Fungus Contamination Sand and Dust The Neptune watch is limited to only 100 pcs and marks a significant battle in world history. The Normandy landings were the landing operations and associated airborne operations on Tuesday, 6 June 1944 of the Allied invasion of Normandy in Operation Overlord during World War II. Codenamed Operation Neptune and often referred to as D-Day , it was the largest seaborne invasion in history. The operation began the liberation of France (and later Western Europe) and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.
